messages:
Maya (eng-platform): Heads-up — HeliumPay is getting repeated 503s on /generate for dedicated pool-beta-3. Customer reports p99 spikes >5s and intermittent errors. Noticed request queue growth on the control plane. Adding details + asking for oncall/infra owners. @Diego (eng-oncall) can you take initial triage?

Diego (eng-oncall): On it. Looking at pool metrics now — GPU util ~98% on pool-beta-3, several OOM retries in the last 12m. Are they pinned to fp16 full model?

Maya (eng-platform): They were pinned to model redwood/alder-13b-v1 (fp16) with no fallback. Traffic spiked after a partner campaign. Routing policy shows zero fallback variants. We need a temporary routing change to a quantized path or smaller model until we stabilize.

Sam (customer-success): Customer flagged a potential SLO breach; legal is asking for ETA. We need a concrete mitigation timeline we can promise.

Lee (eng-sre): I can add a routing override to route 30% -> alder-quant within 15m. I can also spin up one extra node in us-west-2 if capacity is available. Both ops take ~15m; which first?

Maya (eng-platform): Do both in parallel. Priority: (1) route 30% to alder-quant as a quick mitigation, (2) spin an extra node to relieve queue pressure. @OpsBot kick the scaling playbook.

OpsBot: Scaling playbook triggered by Maya — provisioning one g5x2 node in us-west-2. ETA ~18 minutes.

Diego (eng-oncall): Starting a canary: route 5% to alder-quant-13b-q4, monitor latency and error rate for 10m, then ramp to 30% if stable.

Maya (eng-platform): Logged incident HeliumPay-P1-3890004321. Action items: (1) Diego: canary + ramp + verify no regressions (10m checks); (2) Lee: push temporary routing & finalize node spin (ETA ~20m); (3) Maya: notify PM/legal with commitment (2hr mitigation, 24h full patch); (4) Sam: update customer with timeline.

Sam (customer-success): Will message Legal & HeliumPay: "Expect mitigation in ~30m, full fix in 24h."

Diego (eng-oncall): Canary at 5% now — initial metrics look promising: p50 unchanged, p95 down ~15%, error rate stable. Ramping to 30% in 8m if no regressions.

Lee (eng-sre): Node provisioning completed. New node joined pool-beta-3; autoscaler shows healthy.

OpsBot: Routing policy updated: 30% traffic -> redwood/alder-quant-13b-q4. Canary passed checks.

Maya (eng-platform): Good. Next: we still need a persistent PR for fallback routing and smarter autoscaler thresholds. @Diego can you own the PR? Need CR by EOD today.

Diego (eng-oncall): Will open PR for fallback policy + unit/integration tests within 4h. Requesting review from @Lee and @Maya.

Lee (eng-sre): I will review. Add a counter metric "fallback_routed" and an alert threshold so we can detect unexpected fallback volume. Also ensure trace tags include variant.

Maya (eng-platform): Agreed. Also update the Dedicated runbook for surge mitigations. Sam — can you prepare a customer comms template we can send if this recurs?

Sam (customer-success): On it. Will draft comms and send to HeliumPay in ~10m, cc'ing legal.

Maya (eng-platform): Postmortem owners: Diego + Lee + Sam. Expect an initial incident draft in 48h.

Diego (eng-oncall): Ack. I'll gather timeline, canary logs, and config diffs.

Lee (eng-sre): Ack. I'll pull autoscaler events, GPU telemetry, and node join/leave logs.

Sam (customer-success): Ack. I'll attach customer messages, times, and SLA references.

Maya (eng-platform): Closing loop — update this thread with any blockers. Thanks team :pray:

Diego (eng-oncall): Canary dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/heliumpay/3890004321 — updating as we go.

Sam (customer-success): Sent initial comms to HeliumPay; they replied "appreciate the fast response, standing by."

OpsBot: Incident HeliumPay-P1-3890004321 status: mitigation in progress; escalation watchers set: @cto @vp-eng.

Maya (eng-platform): Noted. I'll escalate to leadership if we see recurrence beyond next 2h. Updating incident tracker now.

Diego (eng-oncall): Leaving periodic updates in thread. Next update in ~10m.

Maya (eng-platform): End of thread for now.
